message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you might enjoy for a Friday night movie marathon:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological horror masterpiece with an iconic performance by Jack Nicholson. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A disturbing family drama that turns into a supernatural nightmare. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | A smart thriller that blends social commentary with genuine terror. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Suspenseful, low‑key horror where silence is survival. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that subverts expectations with its unsettling folk rituals. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope with a creepy soundtrack. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation that sets up a larger universe. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror that uses a child’s fear as a metaphor for grief. |
| 9 | **The Ring** (2002) | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic that still feels fresh. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Low‑budget found‑footage film that proves tension can be more effective than gore. |

Feel free to pick one or two from each era—mixing classics with newer releases keeps the night interesting! Enjoy your fright-filled Friday night.
